_help: Copy to settings.json beside this file and keep only what you change. Leave a value out to use the default.
_companion_mode: auto (detect), service (CompanionPi), desktop (the desktop app) or docker
_companion_base: Companion's config folder, the one holding v5.0, if it isn't found by itself
_companion_app: desktop: the program to start, e.g. /opt/companion/companion-launcher or an AppImage
_companion_process: desktop: process names that mean Companion is open
_docker: docker: the container's name, and where it keeps its config inside the container
_companion_owner: service/docker: user:group for config files put in place ('' = whoever owns the folder)
_admin_url: service/docker: the page Open Companion opens
_login_action: tray icon at login: take_and_open, or tray_only (choose Open Companion yourself)
